title: Lucía Guadalupe Mora, Morena Political Liaison & Teacher, Murdered in Chihuahua
author: Jesús Estrada
content:
_This article by Jesús Estrada originally appeared in the[May 13, 2026 edition
of ](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/05/13/estados/asesinan-en-
chihuahua-a-lucia-guadalupe-mora-enlace-politico-de-morena)_[La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/05/13/estados/asesinan-en-
chihuahua-a-lucia-guadalupe-mora-enlace-politico-de-morena) _, Mexico 's
premier left wing daily newspaper._

[Editor's note:

**Chihuahua, Chihuahua**. Teacher Lucía Guadalupe Mora Ávalos, a member of
Morena in the municipality of Valle de Allende, Chihuahua, and identified as
the party's political liaison in that area, died in an armed attack on Tuesday
night.

Personnel from the State Investigation Agency responded to the report of the
homicide, which occurred on Benito Juárez Street in the municipal capital.

The Specialized Prosecutor's Office for Attention to Women Victims of Crime
for Gender and Family Reasons in the southern zone, reported that the victim,
identified as Lucía Guadalupe MA, 53 years old, presented wounds caused by a
projectile from a firearm in different parts of the body.

She was found inside a blue Honda HRV SUV.

Specialists from the Forensic Services Unit processed the scene, where they
secured several .380 caliber and 9mm shell casings.

The body was transferred to the Forensic Medical Service to perform the
corresponding autopsy.

For its part, the Public Prosecutor's Office of the Specialized Prosecutor's
Office for Attention to Women Victims of Crimes for Gender and Family Reasons
initiated the investigation work to clarify the facts.

The leadership of Morena has not commented on the murder of Lucía Guadalupe
Mora, nor has it specified her position within the party's organizational
structure.

[Editor's note: Morena's Chihuahua State Executive Committee released a
statement on the murder of Lucía Guadalupe Mora Ávalos on the morning of May
13th. See below.]
